rules.statement: The RTL shall follow the VLSIT RTL Design Rules v2 (REF-003) as the mandatory baseline for naming, hierarchy, single-clock, reset and synthesis.
The page-word-count check of converted standards must not be treated as a word-for-word legal or semantic review.
Licensed PDFs and converted Markdown must remain outside the deliverable folder and must not be copied or redistributed.
User-approved decisions in §20 may restrict legal protocol behavior but must not contradict it.
